notes.title: The playtest will start on April 3rd!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/89bd9bf66b3fb97d69928784931d88754f3aaf8a.png[/img]

Reminder: Sign-ups for The Way of the Tray playtest are open!

On April 3rd, the first players will be able to come face to face with the mysterious yokai and step into the shoes of a waiter in a Japanese restaurant. Don’t miss out — sign up now!

How to Join?
– Go to the game’s page on Steam and click the "Request Access" button
– Wait for a notification when the playtest access is granted
– Play and share your feedback!

Add The Way of the Tray to your wishlist and follow our social media to stay updated on the latest news:
[list]
[*] Discord: https://discord.gg/yxNxZ5Z8Ta
[*] X: https://x.com/TG_Indie
[/list]

notes.title: Sign Up for the Playtest of The Way of the Tray!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/89bd9bf66b3fb97d69928784931d88754f3aaf8a.png[/img]

Want to be among the first to dive into an exciting new world? We invite you to join the playtest of The Way of the Tray! This is a great chance to experience the gameplay before release, share your impressions, and help us make the game even better.

How to Join?
– Go to the game’s page on Steam and click the "Request Access" button
– Wait for a notification when the playtest access is granted
– Play and share your feedback!

Add The Way of the Tray to your wishlist and follow our social media to stay updated on the latest news:
